summary: Plan farmer-centred extension, field schools and advisory referrals. Build practical monitoring records in this five-day course. Explore the outline.
lede: Agricultural extension services training prepares extension workers and rural advisers to turn farmer priorities into relevant community guidance. It develops needs assessment, participatory learning and advisory-network coordination, including planning farmer field schools or demonstrations and mapping referrals. Participants also practise recording service outcomes and assessing barriers to mobile advisory access.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for people who assess farmer needs, deliver extension activities or coordinate rural advisory services. It suits practitioners who need to adapt field methods, work across provider networks and document service results.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with farm visits, farmer communication or extension activities is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a mobile phone if available; exercises can also use prepared examples without installing an application.
